newsitem.title: USA: Berg Electronics Corp Q4 pro forma profit.
newsitem.headline: Berg Electronics Corp Q4 pro forma profit.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)

NOTE: 1996 and 1995 results pro forma as if initial public offering and refinancing had been effective at December 31. 1995 pro forma net also excludes non-recurring charges. Q4 1996 actual net profit $0.44 a share vs Q4 1995 loss of $0.29.

Q4 1995 actual net loss includes $1,000,000 charge from consolidation of cable facilities and $3,400,000 charge from patent litigation. Q4 1995 actual net loss per share after $3,831,000 in preferred stock requirements.
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Full-year 1996 and 1995 results pro forma.

Full-year 1996 actual net loss $0.89 a share after $18,664,000 extraordinary net charge for recapitalization and $27,335,000 in preferred stock requirements. Full-year 1996 actual net operating profit $0.08 a share, excluding extraordinary charge.
Full-year 1995 actual net loss $0.42 a share after charges taken in fourth quarter, $2,588,000 non-recurring currency gain and $14,741,000 in preferred stock requirements.
